output.reason: The evidence supports the first part: it states that the “Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans & Advances (2024)” was withdrawn/repealed by “Consolidation of Regulations - Withdrawal of circulars (2025)” effective 2025-11-28, and that as of 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force. However, the evidence does not support the conclusion that this means the rules “do not change the current fee shown in the bank documents,” because it only establishes a rule about fees/charges not mentioned in the KFS (during the loan term, without explicit consent) and does not provide evidence about what fees are currently shown in bank documents or how they change after withdrawal.
